2404-6507-7115-8345.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two additional lands.
2404-6507-7115-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more creatures.
2404-6507-7115-8345.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle and another land by tapping them, adding at least {G}{G}{G}
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing a land that wasn't tapped for mana in step 1.
Toph's second ability triggers, earthbending Gaea's Cradle
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending another land you control.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Cast Constant Mists with buyback by paying {1}{G} and sacrificing the land that was earthbent in step 6.
Toph triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, earthbending Gaea's Cradle.
Resolve the second Toph trigger, returning the sacrificed land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
Resolve Constant Mists, returning it to your hand.
Activate the land that entered by tapping it adding at least {1}.
Repeat from step 5.
2404-6507-7115-8345.notes: If the other land that is recurred doesn't produce mana, you must control four or more creatures for the combo to function.

225-573-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-573-2645-3430.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{R}{R}{G}{G}{G} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Gruul Turf
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3532-5078-7656-8176.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5078-7656-8176.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Elena triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

728-3249-5173-5268.easyPrerequisites:
Utopia Vow attached to Grimgrin.
Grimgrin does not have summoning sickness.
728-3249-5173-5268.description:
Activate Grimgrin's ability from Utopia Vow by tapping Grimgrin, adding one mana.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Shambling Ghast, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Shambling Ghast dies, it triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana.
Activate Havengul Lich by paying {1}, allowing you to cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shambling Ghast from your graveyard by paying its casting cost.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature Castable for One Colored Mana

678-2403-5670--52.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 2.
678-2403-5670--52.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
When the creature dies, Moonlit Wake and Enduring Renewal trigger.
Resolve the Moonlit Wake trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the other Angel on the battlefield

969-3259-7917--185.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
969-3259-7917--185.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Seluma, triggering both Breath of Fury and Seluma.
Resolve the Seluma trigger, returning an Angel from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Angel returned in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.
969-3259-7917--185.notes: One of the two additional Angels must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard. If both chosen Angels have haste, then Fervor can be omitted.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it

4094-4682-7890.notablePrerequisites: At least two opponents cannot pay for Smothering Tithe's trigger.
4094-4682-7890.description:
Activate Gleaming Splendor by paying {2}{W}, causing two opponents to each draw a card.
Smothering Tithe triggers twice, creating four Treasure tokens due to Kaya, Geist Hunter
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{W}.
Repeat any number of times.
Once you have near-infinite Treasure tokens, you may repeat the loop targeting yourself as one of the players in step 1, drawing any number of cards.

186-7426-7628-7811.easyPrerequisites: There's a removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
186-7426-7628-7811.description:
Activate Ray Fillet by paying {1} due to Heartstone and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, causing you to draw a card.
Iron Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta triggers, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2034-6972-7727.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Repeat.

2034-3499-5477-5660-7368.description:
Activate Agonasaur Rex's cycling ability by paying {2}{G} and discarding it.
Agonasaur Rex triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Agonasaur Rex from your graveyard to your hand.
Insidious Roots triggers, creating a 0/1 Plant creature token, and then putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control.
Resolve the Agonasaur Rex ability from step 1, causing you to draw a card.
Activate the Plant by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the tapped Plant, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

339-677-2921-7297.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

339-677-3967-7175.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2366-3688-5223-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2366-3688-5223-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Zhur-Taa Ancient triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

1286-6797-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Ajani's Chosen triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat from step 3.

483-2173-2448-5220.easyPrerequisites: It is your precombat main phase.
483-2173-2448-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Firestarter by sacrificing it.
When Goblin Firestarter dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Goblin Firestarter from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Goblin Firestarter ability.
Cast Goblin Firestarter from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

1558-1721-4519.easyPrerequisites: You control at least four additional nontoken artifacts.
1558-1721-4519.description:
If Dance of the Manse is in your graveyard, activate Codex Shredder's second ability by paying {5}, tapping and sacrificing it, returning Dance of the Manse from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it, sacrificing it and sacrificing four other nontoken artifacts you control, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Dance of the Manse by paying {6}{W}{U}, returning Time Sieve, Codex Shredder and four other artifacts from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat each turn.

330-4508-6441.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander, and your commander is a Pirate.
You control at least one additional creature or artifact.
330-4508-6441.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1} and sacrificing another creature or artifact, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2232-2792-5778.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
2232-2792-5778.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers twice and Cloudstone Curio triggers once.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning nothing to your hand.
Resolve the first Great Whale trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Holding priority, activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Great Whale trigger, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning the nontoken Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Great Whale token's trigger, untapping up to seven lands.
Repeat.

565-2909-3542.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}.
565-2909-3542.description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {2}{U}{U}, targeting Palinchron.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Palinchron.
When the Palinchron token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, which you can then target any creatures you control in step 2 to create infinite token copies of them.

774-1714-2137-4826.notablePrerequisites:
High Tide in hand.You control at least two basic Islands.
"Blue" chosen with Gauntlet of Power.
Archelos is untapped.
774-1714-2137-4826.description:
Cast any instant or sorcery spell by paying its mana cost, or wait for an opponent to cast one.
Holding priority, activate two basic Islands by tapping them, adding {U}{U}.
Gauntlet of Power triggers twice, adding {U}{U}.
Holding priority, activate Uyo by paying {2} and returning two basic Islands to your hand, copying the instant or sorcery.
Resolve the copy of the instant or sorcery.
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting two basic Islands from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.
Once you have infinite {U}, you may instead use any other lands you control to get infinite mana those lands produce.

1680-2257-4508.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
1680-2257-4508.description:
Cause an artifact to enter the battlefield under your control.
Reckless Fireweaver triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Malcolm triggers, as Reckless Fireweaver is a Pirate due to Runed Stalactite, creating a Treasure token for each opponent dealt damage this way.
When the Treasure(s) enter, Reckless Fireweaver triggers that many times.
Resolve the first Reckless Fireweaver trigger, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

155-598-1962.notablePrerequisites: Liliana has at least three loyalty counters on it.
155-598-1962.description:
Activate Liliana's third loyalty ability by removing three loyalty counters from it, allowing you to cast Zombie spells from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Shields of Velis Vel either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0}, giving creatures you control +0/+1 and all creature types until end of turn.
Repeat from step 2.

631-2034-2948-5010.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Golgari Thug, adding {C}{C}.
Golgari Thug dies, triggering itself and Grim Haruspex.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting itself on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Grim Haruspex trigger, causing you to draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Activate Initiates of the Ebon Hand by paying {1}, adding {B}.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {1}{B}.
Repeat.

793-1636-2018-2838-3072.notablePrerequisites: Soul Diviner does not have summoning sickness.
793-1636-2018-2838-3072.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Dire Fleet Hoarder.
Dire Fleet Hoarder and Luminous Broodmoth triggers.
Resolve the Dire Fleet Hoarder triggers, creating a treasure token.
Resolve the Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Dire Fleet Hoarder to the battlefield with a flying counter on it.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sorched Rusalka trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it, removing a flying counter from Dire Fleet Hoarder.
Repeat.

2696-3094.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature and/or a land that can tap to produce {3}.
2696-3094.description:
Activate Teferi's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it.
Holding priority, activate the creature and/or land by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Teferi's ability.
Resolve the copy of Teferi's ability, untapping Lithoform Engine and the creature and/or land that can produce at least {3}, and causing you to gain two life.
Repeat from step 2.

1518-1987-3941-4125.notablePrerequisites: Will Kenrith has at least two loyalty counters.
1518-1987-3941-4125.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's -2 ability targeting yourself, reducing the cost of your instant, sorcery, and planeswalker spells by {2} until end of turn and drawing you 2 cards.
Activate Coveted Jewel by tapping it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Coveted Jewel and Shipwreck Dowser, blinking them.
When Shipwreck Dowser enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Coveted Jewel enters the battlefield, draw three cards.
Repeat.

308-1263-4871-5256.notablePrerequisites: You attacked with a creature this turn.
308-1263-4871-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Bloodsoaked Champion.
Bloodsoaked Champion dies, triggering Pitiless Plunderer, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia's ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Bloodsoaked Champion's power.
Activate a Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Bloodsoaked Champion by paying {B}, returning it to the battlefield.
Repeat.

914-3198-3648.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3198-3648.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Cast Lore Drakkis for its mutate cost by paying {U/R}{U/R}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Lore Drakkis's mutate ability triggers, returning Word of Undoing from your graveyard to hand.
Cast Word of Undoing by paying {U}, returning Dockside Extortionist and Lore Drakkis to your hand.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {1}{U}{U/R}{U/R}{R}.
Repeat.
